osgReviewerArms: OSG-12: optional per-PR arm selection precedes the existing effective route and claim. Off and shadow retain the default route. reviewerAttribution: ITP-13: canonical reviewer/account projections are additive runtime/pass metadata and signed reviewed payload data. CLI dispatch and reattach retain validated projections from sanitized context, including initial zero generations. Posting compares canonical model families. Reattach preserves historic receipts and signatures; recorded same-family claims refuse attribution writes and use the existing failed-orphan transition before posted settlement. No new states or smoke promises; account leases retain their existing drain/release semantics.
loadAwareWaits: LOADAR-01: operational waits and lease deadlines scale from unchanged nominal bases through the shared helper. Confirmed live closure launches report still running after N minutes at the effective bound. Ownership states, transitions, retry cadence and once-only page receipts are unchanged.
privilegedAccountPools: ITP-14: declared hammer/remediator pools propose canonical roles using the shared account owner; unknown evidence and local pooled remediation hold through existing deferral/claim-release paths without spending launch/round budget. Fresh exhaustion retains only declared eligible cross-family edges. Dispatcher-owned binding/leases, merge predicates, states and smoke promises are unchanged. Local pooled remediation retries no earlier than 60 seconds after the hold decision, independent of claim age. Enrollment remains operator-only ITP-19.
reviewerAccountPools: ITP-12: declared Claude/Codex reviewer pools acquire shared broker execution capacity before native spawn through an explicitly supported runtime ID. Secret-free account receipts survive runtime and pass settlement. Renewal and recovery retain the original fence; only confirmed drain releases. Held selections cannot mark unreadable fleet quota available, but still reach admission. Unknown admission evidence releases the effective result session claim without charging retry budgets, including after fallback. Existing states, edges and smoke promises are unchanged; live enrollment is operator-only ITP-19.
agyHolderLeases: ITP-11: one canonical gemini-reviewer role leases distinct OS holders at concurrency one. Durable holder claims precede launch; local release receipts remain populated with admission fenced until persistence completes, including overlapping readiness passes. Generation-fenced release retains its claim through cleanup/drain failures and retries on readiness. Dead-owner reclaim reconstructs workspace cleanup from the durable review ID under lock. Failed auth requirements persist during drain and probes back off across restart. Drained failed releases and acquisition-discovered auth holds immediately initiate isolated recovery; successful obsolete-generation probes retain admission fencing without adding auth failures or backoff. Only launching records hold without a PGID; terminal live PGIDs are verified against spawnedAt, proven recycled leaders are excluded, and unknown evidence holds. Stale heartbeats never free live processes. Existing review/run statuses and merge authority remain unchanged.
commentOnlyFinalRoundCiRepair: HAMREDCI-01: a proven comment-only final-round handoff resumes hammer terminal validation with failed CI and stale review head, with or without non-blocking findings or strict non-blocking remediation enabled. Non-conflicting pending-only CI and known rollups without external checks retain the bounded wait from the proven push; empty rollups remain non-green and the deadline restores retain-loop charging. Blocking/unknown blocking findings, structural blocks, hard-stop labels and merge leases retain their gates; exact-head green CI is still required for merge. Existing states, transitions and smoke promises are unchanged.
mergeLeaseFairness: LEASEFAIR-01: daemon PR/head reservations survive watcher passes and restarts, precede closer acquisitions and retain FIFO order within the daemon class. No holder is preempted. Closers release before the first remote-CI wait and reacquire before the final live gate. LEASEFAIR-02 handles any current-base commit absent from the validated head with one in-run rebase and exact-head CI wait while retaining the reacquired lease. Daemon reservations remain ahead of retry acquisition. Both waits and the intervening rebase consume one absolute deadline initialized before the first wait from the once-scaled nominal CI bound; conflict, red CI and expiry release with actual reasons. Successful retry rebuilds head-bound audit and predicate authority. Queue positions accompany contention and overdue wait notices. Existing lifecycle states and transitions are unchanged; the clean offline smoke also verifies priority service without preemption.
hammerRangeResponsibility: HAMNOREREVIEW-01: an unprovable starting base widens the audit range to the reviewed SHA. HAMSELFREBASE-01: successful server-side rebases fetch and detach the scratch checkout at the exact produced SHA and synchronize initialized submodules. Changed-surface revalidation, audit publication including recovery, required-check waiting and merge continue in the same run under the merge lease, preserving existing pending-CI release and reacquisition; foreign head changes still release with head-changed. Existing lifecycle states and smoke promises are unchanged. HAMATTEST-02: authenticated pushed and validated App edges share one provenance chain reader; pushed edges do not certify CI. Proven hammer heads retain closure ownership and exact-head checks remain required. An explicit rereview-exact-head decision on an unbound head executes immediately through the existing per-head orphan review reservation when no live owner exists and ownership reads are certain; reasons persist in watchdog evidence. Queue failures refund the reservation. Existing pending-review transitions execute this decision. Legacy review handoff stops release without a new verdict; mixed safety refusals hold. Current-head closer evidence selects hammer in ordinary automated and ownerless recovery; an explicit shared rereview-exact-head decision takes precedence. The compatibility handoff CLI uses the existing terminal failed-without-merge transition; new hammer runs do not produce handed-to-review records. Historical records remain readable during rolling deployment. Post-rebase snapshot reads retry transient errors within the update-branch cap; permanent failures and exhaustion release the lease. A known API publication whose scratch sync failed is attested and preserved without a fallback push. Explicit exact-head review requests start both idle clocks; absent ownership at the idle bound retains the review route through two recovery attempts and one exhaustion page.
hammerAuditRecovery: HAMATTESTRETRY-01: audit comment delivery retries five times with lease checks and fixed 2/4/8/16-second backoff. Failed delivery records a validated edge in a deferred AMA audit attempt. Recovery posts only for a matching live head, reviewed base and authenticated App identity, before the unchanged provenance predicate. Initial validated-edge delivery failure and recovery delivery failure mark lease release as a retryable audit-comment-unavailable abort; recovery retains the existing pending edge. Existing states, retry caps, merge authority and smoke promises remain unchanged.
ownerlessRecovery: ORPHANACTION-01: settled final-round and exhausted-cycle evidence selects hammer after head movement. Shared settled Comment-only admission evidence prevents refused re-review attempts; readonly captured-pass query errors warn and fall back to filesystem evidence without migration. Proven quota-status and stacked-base read failures refund reservations; an explicit transient holdReason qualifies regardless of the outer reason. Genuine quota exhaustion spends attempts. Exhausted pages include both outcome reasons. Existing lifecycle states, transitions and smoke promises remain unchanged.
reviewCeilingHandoff: CEILINGPUSH-01: a moved head at the delivered-review ceiling retains the prior review as terminal hammer input, admits its native wake independently of the legacy exhaustion dispatch reason or exhaustion snapshot, and settles remediation-closeout as review-ceiling-hammer-owned. Repeated observations retain ownership without another row write or transition log. Existing final-round waits record refusal and page once after 1800 seconds without progress. HAMCLOSEWAIT-01 advances existing waits to a retained running/starting closer launch or confirmed dispatched lease progress timestamp no later than observation time; future timestamps cannot refresh existing waits and only running/starting retained dispatches supply launch progress; stalled/blocked/unknown/succeeded-awaiting-audit-or-merged-signal holds supply none; polling alone never extends the deadline, and other blockers and immediate pages retain their behavior. No new states, edges, review rounds or merge authority.
hammerScratchLifetime: SCRATCHLEAK-01: terminal cleanup retains recorded draining processes and live launch leases; pytest uses one replaceable tmp-tests base under scratch. Startup sweeps reclaim old terminal backlog; cwd-only probe timeouts expire after the idle bound plus twice the existing launch/lease window, requiring readable ps, terminal retry chains and no positive holder. Partial size accounting cannot prevent terminal reclamation. SCRATCHLEAK-02: an atomic candidate cursor resumes oldest-first laps across passes and restarts, including kept candidates and zero-removal laps. Launch/retry and worker ledger reads have separate 10-second timeouts outside the scan budget; timed-out candidates are retained and advanced past. No merge-authority transitions change.

closureOwnerLeaseReclaim: LEASEDEADPID-01: closure-owner arbitration shares pending/dispatched reclaim predicates with dispatch in closer-lease.mjs. Both reclaim predicates accept ISO or numeric epoch-millisecond clocks. Live ownership retains bounded wait/page. Existing evaluation edges are unchanged. LRQSTATUS-01: parked producer blocked_/waiting_ states release active leases as deferred and capacity but retain PR ownership through dispatch receipts; they cannot be reclaimed or redriven while parked or after resuming execution; matching deferred receipts fence redispatch and daemon merge until confirmed terminal launch/retry evidence. Confirmed terminal ledger evidence takes precedence over a stored parked observation; unknown evidence preserves parked ownership.
producerContractReaders: Producer contract readers keep literal caller terminal policies and fail loudly when a canonical policy member is absent or nonterminal in the producer vocabulary. Legacy aliases remain local compatibility policy; dispatch-status probes use their own vocabulary. Weekly fallback applies only without a weeklyMeasurementReason key; a present key, including null, preserves unknown-evidence holds until measured weekly evidence returns. Activation and post-deploy checks require both OpenAI weekly floors to be measured; see docs/producer-contract-readers.md#activation-and-verification. terminalSemantics: Quiescent for this attempt or decision, not irreversible PR completion. Explicit recovery edges may reopen terminal attempts. Closure owner is a recomputed projection; [*] is its evaluation boundary. Lease deletion is record removal, not merge authority. Transitions describe owned lifecycle routes, not arbitrary low-level patch calls. Certified HAM contention parks with UNKNOWN mergeability, alone or with pending CI, retain bounded deferral backoff and expiry rather than immediate operator escalation; red CI still routes to bounded repair. Retryable UNKNOWN deferral requires the PR to remain open at the validated head; moved heads and closed PRs retain terminal refusals.
terminalCloserLeaseReclaim: TERMLEASE-01: terminal superseded/failed-without-merge/deferred leases with terminal ledger or matching dispatch evidence, or a confirmed missing launch, are removed under a nonblocking reclaim lock with observed-owner revalidation, then reacquired through the existing exclusive CAS on the same pass. Positive live launches/retries, unreadable retry chains and otherwise unproven liveness hold; succeeded remains sticky. Superseded dispatches release matching rekeyed leases while preserving successors and review handoffs. Inline and settled background closure blockers identify retained terminal launches. No new statuses or merge/retry authority. LRQSTATUS-01: parked launch/retry evidence explicitly retains terminal deferred lease ownership without reserving capacity. Resumed in-flight launches retain closure ownership; known observations persist under the matching receipt while unknown status/retry evidence cannot erase ownership. Matching deferred receipts, including rekeyed leases, remain visible to capacity scans; positive resumed execution occupies capacity again.
